mcpConfigFix: Owner asked to enable the repo-git MCP so a restarted session can use it. ROOT CAUSE was a generator defect, not just a missing file: install_hooks.ps1 wrote the CLAUDE .mcp.json MCP shape ({command: string, args: [...]}) into .kilo/kilo.json, but Kilo requires {type: 'local', command: [array]}. The server therefore never registered and repo-git.commit was absent from the toolset, which stayed invisible until an agent needed to commit. A SECOND defect compounded it: PowerShell 7's `Set-Content -Encoding utf8` writes a UTF-8 BOM (bytes 239 187 191), which made .kilo/kilo.json unparseable as plain UTF-8 JSON (json.load raises 'Unexpected UTF-8 BOM'). The main checkout's .kilo/kilo.json was correct only because it had been hand-fixed; all three worktrees had the generated wrong shape. FIXES: install_hooks.ps1 now has ONE python merge path for both branches that writes type=local + array command, reads with utf-8-sig to tolerate a pre-existing BOM, writes with plain utf-8 (no BOM), and asserts the shape before exiting; smoke_test.py gained guards so the two schemas cannot drift again (BOM check, type=local, command-is-list, command target, installer-source checks scoped to the kilo branch so the Cursor branch's legitimate Set-Content is not tripped). VERIFIED: smoke_test.py passes ('commit-tool smoke: ok'); the config's own command was spawned over stdio and listed ['validate_message','commit','merge'] with validate_message ok:true, proving registration will work after restart; all four .kilo/kilo.json files (main + 3 worktrees) now audit as OK with bom=False. SIBLING WORKTREES FIXED TOO: rift-gate-20260914 and solid-run-20260912-eb53 had the identical generated defect (wrong shape + BOM); both rewritten targeted-wise (only that worktree's gitignored .kilo/kilo.json), so their next sessions register repo-git as well. scripts/commit-tool/** is unfenced by any other active session (verified against all session records). kilo.json and .kilo/kilo.json are gitignored local-only config and are deliberately NOT committed; only the two tracked files (install_hooks.ps1, smoke_test.py) are.
